column1: # The Z9X recipe (horse_popular, G0082): the published image's signed tar patched with what changed (tools/patch_tar.py),
# then erofs from the tar (--tar=f), as the release kits since 1.0.4 (~/lumen-build-tmp/rNNN). Steps of
# tools/build/engine.py, WHEN<TAB>OP<TAB>ARGS, run on the Mac (Z9X artifacts stay there); the erofs step runs in a
# container with the LineageOS host tools (pack_runner). stage/ is the Mac signing step's output: apk/ (re-signed with
# the release keys), dex/ (odex and vdex against the base's boot image), props/ (the two build.prop files of
# devices/horse_popular/image/z9x_props.py). No test adb of any kind goes into this image. check_image.py and
# lumen_checks.py run from the repository ({REPO}: they read tools/sign, tools/lumen, tools/ota/image, overlay/v1).
# the projector app, the updater and AirPlay (system/app) and the three priv-apps with their odex and vdex
# screen mirroring: the Wi-Fi Direct device type "television" for Windows (apps/LumenWifiP2pOverlay, static RRO, no dex)
# the framework keys overlay and the remote key layouts: the gear held on the XGIMI remotes opens the game menu
# the native UI fifo stub (its model list: the mask is drawn by the Projector app only on these models)
# install from the projector, screen mirroring permissions, the sysconfig, the Google add-on reader
# the two build.prop files (z9x_props.py on the Mac)
# erofs (4 KiB blocks, lz4hc, no inline data, the fixed 2009 time), fsck, extract, every changed member read back
